<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1/datasets/{table}/meanings"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The labels and descriptions readers see for a dataset table and its visible columns, with the layers they come from (tenant overlay, connector pack, table catalogue) and, for a connector table, its origin. Columns a connector pack hides are not listed. A missing, internal or not-enabled connector table is 404 (admin only)
